name: WebDig.Dev Price From for WooCommerce
author: Joao Costa

sections.description:
WebDig.Dev Price From for WooCommerce replaces the default price range (for example “€10.00 – €50.00”) shown on variable and grouped products with a single “From” price, based on the cheapest option available.

Features

  • Shows “From” followed by the lowest price on variable products whose variations have different prices.
  • When the cheapest variation is on sale, shows its regular price crossed out next to its sale price.
  • Shows “From” followed by the lowest price on grouped products.
  • Keeps the WooCommerce price suffix (for example “VAT included”) and the store tax display settings.
  • Works with standard WooCommerce shop, category and single product price displays.
  • Adds the pricefrom CSS class to the “From” label for custom styling.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • No settings required.

Translations

Included: Portuguese (Portugal), Spanish (Spain), French (France) and German. Additional translations are welcome at translate.wordpress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/woo-price-from-in-variable-products directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  4. No additional configuration is required. The plugin will automatically adjust price display for variable and grouped products.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change the price charged to the customer?

No. The plugin only changes how the price is displayed. Cart, checkout and order totals are not affected.

How do I style the “From” label?

Use the .pricefrom CSS class, for example: .price .pricefrom { font-size: 0.85em; }.

Which crossed-out price is shown on sale?

The regular price of the same variation that has the lowest price, so the crossed-out price always corresponds to the price shown.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.1.
  • Fixed: the crossed-out sale price could belong to a different variation than the price shown.
  • Fixed: possible fatal error on grouped products without priced children (PHP 8).
  • Fixed: free (0) child products were ignored on grouped products.
  • Fixed: the WooCommerce price suffix (for example “VAT included”) was removed.
  • Fixed: bundled translations were not loaded because of an invalid language path.
  • Fixed: translated strings showed backslashes in the HTML output.
  • Removed: debug messages written to the PHP error log on every page load.
  • Removed: call to the deprecated woocommerce_variable_sale_price_html filter.
  • Changed: text domain set to woo-price-from-in-variable-products to match the plugin slug (translate.wordpress.org).
  • Changed: functions renamed with a unique webdig_wpf_ prefix to avoid conflicts with WooCommerce.
  • Changed: HTML removed from translatable strings.
  • Added: Requires Plugins: woocommerce header.
  • Added: Portuguese (Portugal) translation; updated Spanish, French and German translations.

1.2.5

  • Fixed a critical issue when verifying HPOS compatibility.
  • Replaced is_enabled method with wc_get_feature to check HPOS activation.
  • Adjusted debug logs to prevent unnecessary errors.
  • Improved compatibility checks for modern WooCommerce environments.
  • Tested up to WooCommerce 9.4.3 and WordPress 6.7.1.

1.2.4

  • Corrected price display issue where HTML tags were rendered as plain text.
  • Replaced esc_html__ with __ for frontend price formatting.
  • Improved handling of grouped product prices.

1.2.3

  • Fixed a PHP notice related to compression (ob_end_flush).
  • Added configuration option to disable output compression in WordPress.
  • Enhanced debugging features for compatibility testing.

1.2.2

  • Improved HPOS compatibility with FeaturesUtil declaration.
  • Adjusted the code to avoid direct interactions with WooCommerce internal classes.
  • Updated POT file to include new strings for compatibility logs.

1.2.1

  • Added robust error handling for compatibility issues.
  • Improved debugging messages for HPOS activation.
  • Minor optimizations to code structure for better readability.

1.2.0

  • Added compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and Remote Logging.
  • Refactored code to avoid direct interactions with wp_postmeta and wp_posts.
  • Improved price display logic for grouped and variable products.
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.7.1 and WooCommerce 9.4.3.
  • Updated minimum PHP requirement to 7.4.
  • Optimized translations and text domain handling.

1.1.0

  • Updated plugin name and branding to “WebDig.Dev WooCommerce – Price From in Variable Products”.
  • Improved price formatting logic for variable products.
  • Added compatibility with WordPress 6.7.1 and WooCommerce 9.4.3.
  • Updated minimum PHP requirement to 7.4.
  • Enhanced translations and text domain loading.
  • Fixed minor issues in grouped product price calculations.

1.0.2

  • Fixed minor bugs.
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.3.1 and WooCommerce 8.1.1.

1.0.1

  • Tested up to WordPress 6.3.1 and WooCommerce 8.1.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Tested up to WordPress 5.2 and WooCommerce 3.6.1.
